correctness.rationale: The finite-field algebra is correct. From \(\phi_\rho^\dagger(y)=\rho y+y^{16}\), a nonzero adjoint-kernel vector satisfies \(\rho=y^{15}\). The kernel of the fifteenth-power map on \(\mathbb F_{64}^\times\) has size \(\gcd(15,63)=3\), exactly \(\mathbb F_4^\times\), so projective normal points biject with the \(21\) singular parameters and the adjoint orthogonality identity yields \(C_\rho=y^\perp\). Hull nontriviality is equivalent to \(\operatorname{Tr}_{64/4}(y)=0\). Eliminating \(y\) from \(y+y^4+y^{16}=0\) and \(\rho=y^{15}\) gives \(\rho^5+\rho^4+1=0\). A fresh independent realization of \(\mathbb F_{64}\) confirmed 21 projective lines/singular parameters and exactly five roots.
